cases.sentence: Ты был в ___ , вернись к нам снова.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating state governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Ты заставил ___ дрожать и расколол ее.
cases.explain: The transitive verb заставил (made) governs the accusative case.
The indirect object of послал (sent) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: ты напоил нас ___ , от которого нас шатает.
cases.explain: The verb напоил (gave to drink) takes the instrumental to indicate what was drunk.

cases.sentence: Но для тех, кто тебя боится, поднял ты ___ .
cases.explain: The transitive verb поднял (raised) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Сохрани нас правой рукой своей и ответь ___ .
cases.explain: The indirect object of ответь (answer) takes the dative case.
The preposition над (over) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Окажи нам помощь в борьбе с ___ .
cases.explain: The preposition с (with/against) governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Ты отверг нас, Боже, и сокрушил. Ты был в гневе, вернись к нам снова.
reading.question: What does the Psalmist ask God to do after being rejected?
reading.explain: The Psalmist asks God to return to them after his rejection and anger.

reading.ru: Ты заставил землю дрожать и расколол ее, исцели ее раны, она содрогается.
reading.question: What has God done to the earth and what should He do?
options: Made it tremble and split; now heal its fractures
reading.correct: Made it tremble and split; now heal its fractures
reading.explain: The text describes God making the earth tremble and split, asking Him to heal its wounds.

reading.ru: Но для тех, кто тебя боится, поднял ты знамя, чтобы они, собравшись к нему, стали для лука недосягаемы.
reading.question: Why did God raise a banner?
options: So those who fear Him could gather to it and escape arrows
reading.correct: So those who fear Him could gather to it and escape arrows
reading.explain: The banner was raised for those who fear God, so they could rally to it and be safe.

reading.ru: Сохрани нас правой рукой своей и ответь нам, чтобы возлюбленные тобой спаслись.
reading.question: What is the purpose of God answering the Psalmist's prayer?
options: So that those loved by God may be saved
reading.correct: So that those loved by God may be saved
reading.explain: God's response will enable the salvation of those whom He loves.

reading.ru: Кто приведет меня в укрепленный город? Кто доведет меня до Идома?
reading.question: What is the Psalmist asking about?
options: Who will lead him to fortified cities
reading.correct: Who will lead him to fortified cities
reading.explain: The verse asks who will bring him to a fortified city and lead him to Edom.

reading.ru: С Богом мы одержим победу, Он не звергнет наших врагов.
reading.question: What does the Psalmist declare about victory?
options: With God we will win; He will defeat our enemies
reading.correct: With God we will win; He will defeat our enemies
reading.explain: The affirmation is that with God's help, they will achieve victory and He will defeat their adversaries.
